item.description: ### Fixed - **The lock-screen Live Activity now goes away when your agents finish.** It used to sit there for up to an hour afterwards, still showing the last thing it saw — so a glance at your phone could tell you an agent was working when it had finished minutes ago. It now shows the finished fleet briefly and then dismisses itself. Starting another agent brings it straight back. - **iPhone: the lock-screen Live Activity could freeze on a stale state.** When several agents changed state in quick succession, iOS would quietly stop delivering updates for a while — leaving the lock screen showing something that had finished minutes earlier. Perch now tells iOS it needs frequent updates. (iPhone app only; you can turn frequent updates off for Perch in iOS Settings if you'd rather save battery.) *Already on TestFlight as build 39.*
